title: Contour Bunding in Himachal Pradesh
subject: Geography
caption: Contour lines with bunds on a sloping hill illustrating contour bunding.
altText: A diagram showing a gently sloping hill represented by a gray polygon. Three blue contour lines run across the slope, each labeled Contour line 1, 2, and 3. Small brown semi‑circular bunds are placed on each contour line and labeled Bund. The title 'Contour Bunding in Himachal Pradesh' appears at the top, and the word 'Slope' labels the ground area.
